title: JFK Assassination Records — 2025 Documents Release
source_scope: 2025 release batches and access instructions; NARA notes continuing digitization
research_use: Identify an individual release document, then capture its own file identity
critical_limitation: Records may contain personal information about living people; availability does not license republication of personal details
rights_status: NARA federal-work guidance; item-level third-party/privacy assessment

title: Pentagon Papers
source_scope: Complete declassified Defense Vietnam Task Force report as released by NARA with Presidential Libraries
research_use: Select part/volume and preserve original report pagination, not a newspaper excerpt
critical_limitation: The 1971 published excerpts were incomplete; use the NARA report for source comparison
rights_status: NARA federal-work guidance; examine item contents before reuse

title: COINTELPRO
source_scope: FBI Vault gateway organized into subject-related subcollections
research_use: Follow the particular subcollection and document PDF, capture file/page identity
critical_limitation: Historic FBI classifications are period labels, not neutral descriptions or FV endorsement; a release is not a complete program history
rights_status: FBI public information policy; any specific reproduced item needs separate review

title: VENONA Documents
source_scope: NSA VENONA archive with translated message releases, date and topical indexes
research_use: Record translated document's date and archival title plus translation status
critical_limitation: A translation is not raw intercepted communication; limitations of decryption and editorial context must remain visible
rights_status: Link only pending item-level rights and scan provenance confirmation

title: FRUS: Iran, 1951–1954, Second Edition
source_scope: 2018 edition; documents 1–375 with preface, sources, index and downloadable edition
research_use: Cite volume, document number, document date and editorial footnotes
critical_limitation: FRUS is a selected edited official documentary history, not every original agency file
rights_status: FRUS published text public domain per Office of the Historian

title: FRUS: Guatemala, 1952–1954
source_scope: 2003 volume; documents 1–287, editor notes and indexes
research_use: Start from a document number and inspect its source note and any omitted passages
critical_limitation: Editorial selection and release limitations; avoid treating an absent record as evidence of absence
rights_status: FRUS published text public domain per Office of the Historian

title: The Nixon Collection
source_scope: 2022 Agency story pointing toward eight trip-preparation intelligence products
research_use: Follow the linked document collection before treating an image or claim as primary evidence
critical_limitation: The linked page is a narrative introduction, not itself an original 1972 intelligence document
rights_status: CIA public-site material generally usable unless individually copyrighted; original documents require item check

title: President’s Daily Brief — Kennedy and Johnson
source_scope: 2015 overview booklet about release of approximately 2,500 briefing documents
research_use: Follow primary briefings; cite each dated PDB rather than this explanatory booklet
critical_limitation: This URL identifies a 40-page overview and historic release, not every individual daily brief
rights_status: CIA public-site policy with copyright and credit caveats

title: FRUS: Cuban Missile Crisis and Aftermath
source_scope: 1996 volume XI; documents 1–390, sources and editorial annotations
research_use: Compare dated document text against meeting recordings or other source series when available
critical_limitation: Published selections and annotations are distinct from underlying raw archives
rights_status: FRUS published text public domain per Office of the Historian

title: CIA Freedom of Information Act Electronic Reading Room
source_scope: CIA FOIA digital records and thematic collections; some pages require JavaScript
research_use: Record stable item title, CIA declassification identifier and PDF page, not only search URL
critical_limitation: Search visibility is not complete CIA holdings; some content requires JS, some items withhold portions
rights_status: CIA public-site policy with item-specific copyright exceptions

title: FRUS: Congo, 1960–1968
source_scope: 2013 volume XXIII; documents 1–582 and published errata
research_use: Check the errata, document source note and original document date
critical_limitation: The modern FRUS publication date is not the historical document date
rights_status: FRUS published text public domain per Office of the Historian

title: Iran-Contra Scandal — Reagan Library Topic Guide
source_scope: Collection guide and inventory with archive contact route; page updated May 8, 2025
research_use: Record collection, folder and box; request item-level material when not digitized
critical_limitation: Topic guide explicitly warns that some material remains withdrawn under FOIA restrictions
rights_status: NARA holdings not uniformly unrestricted; request item-specific rights and access conditions
